policy: Unpublished Snapshot v5 uses Starter openings and explicit Direct MCP server toolAccessMode ALL/ALLOWLIST and assistant mcpBindings with toolSelection ALL/ALLOWLIST; ALL follows dynamic discovery and ALLOWLIST must be nonempty, allowedTools and toolNames are required, full Tool JCS contractHash and AUTO/REQUIRE_CONFIRMATION policy. v5 server-only assistant references are retired; missing tool fields require explicit draft authoring. Retained published v4 uses independent DTOs, original bytes/hash and republish recovery. API v1, Bridge v3, Relay workspace protocol v2 and usage targetVersion 2 remain unchanged. Current v5 Android consumer verification is pending; Core-generated exports alone do not prove deployment compatibility. Gateway remains a separate later stage.
